### Finish on your device

- **B01, B13 and B16.** Enter the date you complete the form, one digit per box in the bank’s required order. Confirm whether you have any additional nationality and enter your email address.
- **B12.** The form says “County of birth.” Confirm whether the bank means county or country, then copy the relevant part of your restored birthplace. Supply it locally if the stored birthplace lacks that detail.
- **B14 and B15.** I used your current UK home address for both residential and postal mail. After restoration, split it across the available lines, put the postcode in its own box, and include the country in the address. Add the postcode locally if it is missing from the stored address.
- **B17–B20.** Use the home or cell row that matches your restored number. Split it into the country code, area code or mobile prefix as applicable, and remaining digits. A separate home or cell number, work number, and fax number are missing. Supply those locally if applicable.
- **Capital letters.** After restoration, put text entries in capitals and adjust the passport birth date by hand if the bank requires a different format.
